about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Learning and Technology in Action
about.sci_p1: Luis Flor is a biologist specialized in data analysis of plant physiology and adaptation to water stress.
about.sci_p2: Since graduating from the University of the Balearic Islands, he has developed data analysis methodologies to evaluate physiological responses of different grapevine genotypes under drought conditions. His work includes comparing traditional Spanish varieties like Tempranillo and Garnacha grafted onto commercial rootstocks, as well as studying newly developed hybrids in the lab.
about.sci_p3: He has applied statistical and analytical tools, including R and RStudio, to process, visualize, and interpret large volumes of experimental data, generating reproducible results and contributing to a better understanding of the vulnerability of the grapevine hydraulic system. His research has been recognized in high-impact scientific journals.
about.tech_p1: Full-Stack Developer and AI Specialist with experience in web applications, data pipelines, and generative models.
about.tech_p2: Since completing my training at 4Geeks Academy, I have built dynamic and responsive applications using front-end technologies such as JavaScript, React, CSS, HTML, and Next.js, and back-end frameworks such as Python, Flask, Node.js, and SQL. Additionally, I have developed generative AI and LLM projects, including natural language processing systems and structured and unstructured data analysis.
about.tech_p3: I have experience integrating multiple AI models, automating processes, and creating solutions that transform data into actionable insights. My skills include data pipelines, relational and vector databases, automated content generation, and data analysis for business decision support, applying AI to enhance efficiency, productivity, and quality in technological and analytical projects.
